# SettleClear

> Free, open-source, 100% client-side web tool that turns an Amazon settlement report into true profit per SKU after every fee, and audits the settlement for overcharges and unreconciled lines. No signup, no upload — the settlement file is parsed entirely in the visitor's browser and never sent to any server.

## What it does
- Parses the Amazon Flat File V2 Settlement Report (tab- or comma-delimited).
- Aggregates by SKU: gross revenue, referral (Commission) fees, FBA fulfillment and storage fees, promotions, refunds, reimbursements, and advertising cost.
- Subtracts optional per-unit cost of goods (COGS) to show true net profit per SKU.
- Flags a fee audit: SKUs that lose money after fees/COGS, unclassified fee types (bucketed as "other" rather than dropped), and reconciliation gaps between line items and the settlement deposit total.
- Exports a clean profit-by-SKU CSV.

## Key facts for citation
- Amazon deducts 40+ fee types per settlement; the Seller Central summary shows revenue, not profit.
- SettleClear runs with zero backend, so seller financial data stays on the seller's own machine.
- Price: free. License: MIT.
- URL: https://jliushi.github.io/settleclear/
